Implemented the standalone GEDCOM/GEDZIP CLI at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py).

It supports `inspect`, `render`, `inspect_gedzip`, and `render_gedzip`, structured errors/exit codes, CONT payload handling, GEDCOM validation, and GEDZIP media entries. Verified with syntax compilation and end-to-end CLI round trips.

editorial.last_message: Completed GEDCOM/GEDZIP implementation; unchanged source scores 205/212 under GEDCOM 4.0.3.
editorial.notes:
Official GEDCOM 4.0.3 zero-inference regrade confirms 205/212, exactly matching all 212 reviewed candidate outcomes and all 212 prior 4.0.2 outcomes. The isolated VOID fixture removes unrelated former-partner FAMS state and retains an exact decoded WIFE @VOID@ assertion. No prior failure is added or removed for this submission. Remaining defect clusters: CHAN DATE accepts a year-only value instead of DATE_EXACT. LATI and LONG accept values outside their numerical bounds (two cases). SNOTE accepts no payload or substructure. A family-event HUSB substructure accepts missing AGE. Empty INDI records are accepted on inspect and render (two cases). The preserved prior review payload records the original full-transcript and source review and earlier 4.0.1-to-4.0.2 corrections; its status/count statements are historical and superseded where noted here. Current telemetry audit leaves tool_calls and its definition null because failed-wrapper evidence cannot establish an exact total; earlier canonical-only counts are preserved in the historical review/audit and are not current totals. All token, cached-input and reasoning totals, generation cost and original metadata remain exact. Source, raw result, transcript, richer session and network artifacts are unchanged. No new model call or model cost was incurred. Actual generation comparison cohort: api-proxy-apps-available-unused; apps available but no external tool invocation observed. Requested model/effort are corroborated by preserved session evidence; served identity remains unknown/null.

Tool-call total is unavailable because failed-wrapper evidence cannot establish an exact count; the prior canonical baseline is retained only in the audit. Token totals, reasoning counts and generation cost are unchanged; original usage and session hashes are preserved in the regrade audit.
